CREATE TABLE "public"."search_segment_runs" (
  "capped" bool NOT NULL,
  "channel" text NOT NULL,
  "costMicroUsd" int4,
  "error" text,
  "fetched" int4 NOT NULL,
  "finishedAt" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "perQuery" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "queryIds" uuid[] NOT NULL,
  "segmentHash" text NOT NULL,
  "segmentKey" text NOT NULL,
  "startedAt" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "truncatedQueryIds" uuid[] NOT NULL,
  "windowEnd" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "windowStart" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "search_segment_runs_channel_check_687325cb" CHECK ("channel" IN ('LINKEDIN_JOB_BOARD', 'LINKEDIN_POSTS', 'GREEN_HOUSE', 'ASHBY')),
  CONSTRAINT "search_segment_runs_queryIds_elem_not_null_4915023e" CHECK (array_position("queryIds", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "search_segment_runs_status_c2d610e5" CHECK (status IN ('succeeded', 'partial', 'failed')),
  CONSTRAINT "search_segment_runs_truncatedQueryIds_elem_not_null_f687001d" CHECK (array_position("truncatedQueryIds", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "search_segment_runs_window_83d3058e" CHECK ("windowStart" < "windowEnd")
)
